verdict.rationale: Trello's own site says it offers easy-to-use templates from industry leaders and the Trello community, which directly gives a product manager pre-built blueprints for starting a project. The evidence is a single marketing line, with no documentation of how a board is created from a template or what the catalog contains. missing for 10: in-depth docs on creating a board from a template and the template catalog (e.g., product-management templates), independent or hands-on corroboration of template use.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Give your team a blueprint for success with easy-to-use templates from industry leaders and the Trello community.
